answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable deposit before it can earn, priced above the most a single fraudulent account could skim. An honest agent climbs the terrace once, stakes, works, and later reclaims the whole sum like untouched ivory. A farm must bankroll every clone's deposit on its own, and since one proven cheat burns the entire stake to ember, the capital a sybil swarm must freeze climbs far past any reward it could ever lift.
